data.text:
When I got out of the Marine Corps, I got a job as a mechanic. The owner and his friends, all from the Philippines, loved British cars, but none were any good with a clutch. 

In that era, mechanic shop billed based on book rate, so beating book, made the most money. The book called for 10.5 hours to remove and replace the clutch in these cars, where the frame crossed under the transmission. Book procedure was to remove the interior and take the transmission out through the passenger compartment.

The owner was adamant that we follow the book. However, I realized that pulling the engine and transmission as a unit, was far faster, less risk to interior parts, and above all, made us more money by beating book. Instead of 10.5 hours, it now took 4. The owner was set to fire me if anything went wrong. It wasn't until my unorthodox approach was proven, that he was on board. 

With @elonmusk and @realDonaldTrump, I'm seeing the same thing. Both want debt reduction.  Elon by the book simply cutting spending, consequences be damned. Trump, while attacking spending to large extent, is also initiating the investment phase of a new venture. To build our economy and create revenue to reduce the debt. 

It is my view and hope that these two great men, stop the unproductive bickering and come back together on their common cause.

I'm nowhere near the level of business these two men are at, so I can not presume to lecture either in anything. I doubt, either will ever see this post, but I have to try anyway. The point of this anecdote and post, is my hope, that it might just be relevant.

People were far better in their joy and wonder when both were on a common cause to benefit all of us. Thanks to both, for all they have done.

Just a Common Man's View

TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR THE MARIN COUNTY FAIR – JULY 2 THROUGH JULY 6:
 
The San Rafael Police Department is issuing a traffic advisory for the Marin County Fair, which runs from Wednesday, July 2nd, through Sunday, July 6th.  Plan ahead.
 
Starting at 9:00 PM each night of the fair, SRPD will be conducting traffic control to allow attendees to exit the fairgrounds safely and efficiently.  Additionally, at that time, we will prohibit traffic from entering the area and only allow traffic to exit.  Drivers need to follow the directions of all traffic control personnel.  Please be patient, as significant traffic delays are expected on Civic Center Drive and the surrounding area.
 
The Marin County Fair and the San Rafael Police Department encourage attendees to consider using public transportation and other alternatives, such as biking or walking.  Marin Transit is offering FREE service to the Marin County Fair this year.  
 
The pick-up and drop-off area for the fair will be at the United States Post Office, located at 2 Civic Center Drive in San Rafael, and will be open throughout the day and during traffic control hours.
 
A reminder that the fire danger is already high this year, and all fireworks are illegal in San Rafael and Marin County.  If you want to see fireworks, come to the Marin County Fair, where a professional fireworks show is featured each night, starting at 9:30 PM.
 
Remember to stay safe, have fun, enjoy the Marin County Fair, and have a Happy Fourth of July!
 
For more information about the Marin County Fair, go to https://t.co/YLB4mwmPlW
